castles.name: Wallingford
castles.quote: 8 were destroyed for the castle;

castles.name: Windsor
castles.quote: Windsor Castle is in the 1/2 hide.

castles.name: Cambridge
castles.quote: This single ward was accounted as two before 1066 but 27 houses have been destroyed for the castle.

castles.name: Rhuddlan
castles.quote: In the manor of Rhuddlan itself a castle has been newly built, likewise called Rhuddlan.

castles.name: Penwortham
castles.quote: Now there is a castle.

castles.name: Launceston
castles.quote: The Count's castle is there.

castles.name: Trematon
castles.quote: !1!] The Count has a castle there, and a market which pays 3s [!1! a year.

castles.name: Peveril (Castleton)
castles.quote: [BLACKWELL Wapentake] Arnbiorn and Hunding held the land of William Peverel's castle in CASTLETON.

castles.name: Okehampton
castles.quote: [his] castle is sited there.

castles.name: Wareham Castle (Kingston entry)
castles.quote: Of the manor of Kingston the King has 1 hide, on which he built Wareham Castle;

castles.name: Rayleigh
castles.quote: In this manor Swein made his castle.

castles.name: Gloucester
castles.quote: Where the castle is sited there were 16 houses which do not exist now, and 14 houses in the Borough of the City have been destroyed.

castles.name: Chepstow
castles.quote: [In IS COED Commote] Earl William built the castle of CHEPSTOW and in his time paid only 40s from the ships going into the woodland.

castles.name: Small castle (Berkeley, Sharpness entry)
castles.quote: In SHARPNESS 5 hides which belong to Berkeley, which Earl William placed outside to build a small castle.

castles.name: Castle at Alvington, Isle of Wight
castles.quote: now for 2 hides, because a castle stands on one virgate.

castles.name: Wigmore
castles.quote: In HEZETRE Hundred Ralph of Mortimer holds WIGMORE Castle.

castles.name: Monmouth
castles.quote: [In Wales] [CASTLERY] In MONMOUTH CASTLE the King has 4 ploughs in lordship. Value of what the King has in this castle, 100s. Saint-Florent of Saumur holds the church of this castle and all the tithe, with 2 carucates of land.

castles.name: Clifford
castles.quote: [CASTLE outside Hundred] Ralph of Tosny holds CLIFFORD Castle. This castle is in the kingdom of England and not subject to any Hundred or customary dues. Gilbert the sheriff holds it at a revenue, both the Borough [Clifford Castle] and the plough . In this castlery Roger holds land for 4 ploughs;

castles.name: Richard's Castle
castles.quote: In CUTESTORNES Hundred [In `WOLFHAY' Hundred] Robert also holds 5 1/2 hides in the castlery of [Richards] CASTLE.

castles.name: Ewyas Harold
castles.quote: [CASTLE] Alfred of Marlborough holds the castle of EWYAS [Harold] from King William. The King himself granted him the lands which Earl William, who had refortified the castle, had given him; The King also granted him the land of Ralph of Bernay which belonged to the castle. Value of this castle of Ewyas [Harold] £10.

castles.name: Caerleon (castlery)
castles.quote: [In Wales] [CASTLERY] William of Ecouis holds 8 carucates of land in the castlery of CAERLEON.

castles.name: Huntingdon
castles.quote: On the castle site there were 20 messuages [liable] for all customary dues, which paid 16s 8d a year to the King's revenue.

castles.name: Canterbury
castles.quote: [The houses] of 32 others who were there have been destroyed, 11 in the city ditch, the Archbishop [of Canterbury] has 7 of them, the Abbot of St Augustine's another 14 in exchange for the castle.

castles.name: Lincoln
castles.quote: Of the said unoccupied messuages 166 were destroyed because of the castle; the remaining 74 are unoccupied outside the castle's perimeter, not because of the oppression of the Sheriffs and officers, but because of misfortune, poverty and the ravages of fire.

castles.name: Stamford
castles.quote: but now there are as many except for 5 which are unoccupied because of the construction of the castle.

castles.name: Norwich
castles.quote: Also on the land of which [Earl] Harold had the jurisdiction, there are 15 burgesses and 17 empty messuages which are in the occupation of the castle premises. Also in the Borough there are 190 messuages empty in this [area] which was in the King's and the Earl's jurisdiction and 81 in the occupation of the castle.

castles.name: Rockingham
castles.quote: It was waste when King William ordered a castle to be built there.

castles.name: Shrewsbury
castles.quote: The English burgesses of SHREWSBURY state that it is very hard on them that they pay as much tax as was paid before 1066, although the Earl's castle has taken over 51 messuages and 50 other messuages are unoccupied and 43 French burgesses hold messuages which paid tax before 1066 and the Earl has himself given to the Abbey, which he is building there, 39 burgesses who once paid tax likewise with t

castles.name: Oswestry (Maesbury entry)
castles.quote: Reginald has built the castle of Oswestry there.

castles.name: Montgomery
castles.quote: In WITTERY Hundred The Earl has built the castle called MONTGOMERY himself; in Castlewright 2 hides;

castles.name: Holdgate
castles.quote: Helgot has a castle, and 2 ploughs in lordship and 4 slaves and 3 villagers, 3 smallholders and 1 Frenchman with 3 1/2 ploughs.

castles.name: Montacute (Bishopstone entry)
castles.quote: His castle, called Montacute, is there.

castles.name: Dunster
castles.quote: his castle is there.

castles.name: Tutbury
castles.quote: In PIREHILL Hundred [In OFFLOW Hundred] Henry of Ferrers has TUTBURY Castle. In the Borough [Tutbury] around the castle are 42 men who live only by their trading;

castles.name: Stafford (Chebsey entry, castle destroyed by 1086)
castles.quote: To this manor belonged land at Stafford on which the King ordered a castle to be built;

castles.name: Eye
castles.quote: W[illiam] Malet made his castle at Eye and, on the same day that there was a market on the Bishop's manor, W[illiam] Malet established another market in his castle.

castles.name: Hastings (castlery)
castles.quote: he held it later until King William gave the castlery of Hastings to the Count.

castles.name: Arundel
castles.quote: [In Arundel Rape] [In BINSTED Hundred] ARUNDEL CASTLE before 1066 paid 40s from a mill;

castles.name: Bramber (Washington entry)
castles.quote: Bramber Castle is situated in one of these hides.

castles.name: Warwick
castles.quote: and 4 are waste, because of the castle site.

castles.name: Dudley
castles.quote: His castle is there.

castles.name: [St Stephens by] Launceston
